Model.Name: LifeModelReserving
Model.Notes: Reserving model layer - contains the present value of cash flows and discounting functionality

Formula.Name: AccidentalDeathBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AccidentalDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedAccidentalDeath(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AccidentalDeathUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AccidentalDeathBEL(t + 1) - (AccidentalDeathBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionAAWBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AcquisitionAAWBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedAquisitionAAW(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionAAWUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return AcquisitionAAWBEL(t + 1) - (AcquisitionAAWBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.AcquisitionAAW_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: AcquisitionExpenses
Formula.Value: Return InitExpPerPolBEL(t) + InitExpPercPremBEL(t) + AcquisitionAAWBEL(t)

Formula.Name: BalDate
Formula.Value: 'Return GetBalDate(t - PeriodIF(), SMCoreModel.ValnDate, StepsPY) Return SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)

Formula.Name: CEPCBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CEPCBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedClaimExpPerClaim(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.CEPC_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CEPCUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CEPCBEL(t + 1) - (CEPCBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPerClaim_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: CUEntrepo
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t)

Formula.Name: CU_Current_Service
Formula.Value: 'If Date.FromOADate(ValDateStep(t)) = SMCoreModel.NextValnDate Then If Date.FromOADate(SMCoreModel.BalDate(t)) = SMCoreModel.NextValnDate Then Return CU_func(t) End If

Formula.Name: CU_Future_Service
Formula.Value:
'If Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)) = SMCoreModel.NextValnDate Then ' Return FutureServiceCU(t) 'End If
If ValMonth(t) = 0 Then Return FutureServiceCU(t) End If

Formula.Name: CU_func
Formula.Value: If ValMonth(t) = 0 Return 0 Else If t < ProjTerm() Return (Math.Max(Math.Max(SMCoreModel.Accidental_Death_cover(t), SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_cover(t)), Math.Max(SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_cover(t), SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_cover(t))) + SMCoreModel.Death_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_cover(t) + SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t)) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t - 1) Else Return 0 End If

Formula.Name: CashBackBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CashBackBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedCashbackBenefit(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Cashback_Benefits_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CashBackUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CashBackBEL(t + 1) - (CashBackBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Periodic_CashBack_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedClaimPercClaimAmt(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: ClaimPercClaimAmtUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL(t + 1) - (ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.ClaimExpPercClaimAmt_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: Claims
Formula.Value: Return DeathBEL(t) + AccidentalDeathBEL(t) + NaturalDeathBEL(t) + PermanentDisabilityBEL(t) + TerminalIllnessBEL(t) + TemporaryDisabilityBEL(t) + RetrenchmentBEL(t) + CriticalIllnessBEL(t) + FuneralBEL(t) + CashBackBEL(t) + SurrenderBEL(t)

Formula.Name: Comission
Formula.Value: Return ComissionBEL(t) + ComissionClawbackBEL(t)

Formula.Name: ComissionBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ComissionBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedComission(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Comission_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: ComissionClawbackBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ComissionClawbackBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedComissionClawback(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.ComissionClawback_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: ComissionClawbackUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ComissionClawbackBEL(t + 1) - (ComissionClawbackBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Comission_Clawback_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: CommissionUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return ComissionBEL(t + 1) - (ComissionBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Renewal_Comission_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: CriticalIllnessBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CriticalIllnessBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedCriticalIllness(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: CriticalIllnessUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return CriticalIllnessBEL(t + 1) - (CriticalIllnessBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Critical_Illness_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: DeathBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return DeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedDeath(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: FuneralBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FuneralBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedFuneral(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Funeral_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: FuneralCoverUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FuneralBEL(t + 1) - (FuneralBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Funeral_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: FutureServiceCU
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return FutureServiceCU(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + CU_func(t + 1) End If

Formula.Name: GrossBEL
Formula.Value: Return PremiumsFinal(t) + RenewalExpenses(t) + Comission(t) + AcquisitionExpenses(t) + Claims(t)

Formula.Name: Inf_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.Inf_input()

Formula.Name: InitExpPerPolBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPerPolBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedInitExpensePP(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.InitialExpensePP_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPerPolUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPerPolBEL(t + 1) - (InitExpPerPolBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.InitialExpPP_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPercPremBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPercPremBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedInitExpPerPrem(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: InitExpPercPremUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return InitExpPercPremBEL(t + 1) - (InitExpPercPremBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.InitialExpPercPremium_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: NOM_input
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.NOM_input()

Formula.Name: NaturalDeathBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return NaturalDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedNaturalDeath(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: NaturalDeathUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return NaturalDeathBEL(t + 1) - (NaturalDeathBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Natural_Death_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PPEBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PPEBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedPPE(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PPE_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PPEUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PPEBEL(t + 1) - (PPEBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Per_pol_exp_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PercCUExpenseUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercCUexpenseBEL(t + 1) - (PercCUexpenseBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Perc_CU_exp_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PercCUexpenseBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercCUexpenseBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedPercCUExpense(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PercCUExpense_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercPremExpenseBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercPremExpenseBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedPercPremExpense(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.PercPremiumExpense_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PercPremExpenseUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PercPremExpenseBEL(t + 1) - (PercPremExpenseBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Perc_premium_exp_func(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PeriodIF
Formula.Value: 'Return DateSpan.TermInMonths(SMCoreModel.CoverStartDate, SMCoreModel.ValuationDate) Return SMCoreModel.PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: PermanentDisabilityBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PermanentDisabilityBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedPermanentDisability(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PermenentDisabilityUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PermanentDisabilityBEL(t + 1) - (PermanentDisabilityBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Permanent_Disability_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: PremiumsBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return PremiumsBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedPremiums(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Premiums_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: PremiumsFinal
Formula.Value: Return PremiumsBEL(t)

Formula.Name: PremiumsUnwind
Formula.Value: 'Return NextValPVPremiums(t) - (PVPremiums(t) + PVPremiumRelease(t)) If t < ProjTerm() Return PremiumsBEL(t + 1) - (PremiumsBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.PremiumCF(t)) End If

Formula.Name: ProjTerm
Formula.Value: Return SMCoreModel.ProjTerm

Formula.Name: RIAccidentalDeathBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIAccidentalDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.AccidentalDeathRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIAccidentalDeathUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIAccidentalDeathBEL(t + 1) - (RIAccidentalDeathBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.AccidentalDeathRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RICU
Formula.Value: Return (Math.Max(Math.Max(SMCoreModel.AccidentalDeathRICover(t), SMCoreModel.NaturalDeathRICover(t)), Math.Max(SMCoreModel.TerminalIllnessRICover(t), SMCoreModel.TemporaryDisabilityRICover(t))) + SMCoreModel.DeathRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.PermanentDisabilityRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.RetrenchmentRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.CriticalIllnessRICover(t) + SMCoreModel.FuneralRICover(t)) * SMCoreModel.Healthy_PRO(t)

Formula.Name: RICriticalIllnessBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RICriticalIllnessBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.CriticalIllessRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RICriticalIllnessUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RICriticalIllnessBEL(t + 1) - (RICriticalIllnessBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.CriticalIllnessRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIDeathBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.DeathRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIDeathUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIDeathBEL(t + 1) - (RIDeathBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.DeathRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIFuneralBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFuneralBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.FuneralRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIFuneralUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFuneralBEL(t + 1) - (RIFuneralBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.FuneralRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIFutureServiceCU
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIFutureServiceCU(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t)) ^ (-1) + RICU(t) End If

Formula.Name: RINaturalDeathBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RINaturalDeathBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.NaturalDeathRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RINaturalDeathUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RINaturalDeathBEL(t + 1) - (RINaturalDeathBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.NaturalDeathRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIPermanentDisabilityBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIPermanentDisabilityBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.PermanentDisRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIPermanentDisabilityUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIPermanentDisabilityBEL(t + 1) - (RIPermanentDisabilityBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.PermanentDisabilityRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RIRetrenchmentBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RIRetrenchmentBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.RetrenchmentRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RIRetrenchmentUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RIRetrenchmentBEL(t + 1) - (RIRetrenchmentBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.RetrenchmentRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RITemporaryDisabilityBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RITemporaryDisabilityBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.TemporaryDisabilityRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RITemporaryDisabilityUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RITemporaryDisabilityBEL(t + 1) - (RITemporaryDisabilityBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.TemporaryDisabilityRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RITerminalIllnessBEL
Formula.Value: 'No reinsurance t_discounting If t < ProjTerm() Return RITerminalIllnessBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.TerminalIllnessRIRecoveries(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-0) End If

Formula.Name: RITerminalIllnessUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RITerminalIllnessBEL(t + 1) - (RITerminalIllnessBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.TerminalIllnessRICover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: RenewalExpenses
Formula.Value: Return PPEBEL(t) + PercPremExpenseBEL(t) + PercCUexpenseBEL(t) + CEPCBEL(t) + ClaimPercClaimAmtBEL(t)

Formula.Name: RetrenchmentBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RetrenchmentBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedRetrenchment(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: RetrenchmentUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return RetrenchmentBEL(t + 1) - (RetrenchmentBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Retrenchment_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: SurrenderBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return SurrenderBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedSurrender(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Surrender_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: SurrenderUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return SurrenderBEL(t + 1) - (SurrenderBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Surrender_cover_factor(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: TemporaryDisabilityBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TemporaryDisabilityBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedTemporaryDisability(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: TemporaryDisabilityUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TemporaryDisabilityBEL(t + 1) - (TemporaryDisabilityBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Temporary_Disability_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: TerminalIllnessBEL
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TerminalIllnessBEL(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-1) + SMLifelModelCF.ExpectedTerminalIllness(t + 1) * (1 + fnRiskDiscountRate(t + 1)) ^ (-SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_t_discounting) End If

Formula.Name: TerminalIllnessUnwind
Formula.Value: If t < ProjTerm() Return TerminalIllnessBEL(t + 1) - (TerminalIllnessBEL(t) + SMCoreModel.Terminal_Illness_cover(t + 1)) End If

Formula.Name: ValMonth
Formula.Value: Return t - PeriodIF()

Formula.Name: fnRiskDiscountRate
Formula.Value: If t <= ProjTerm() If SMCoreModel.NonUnit_discount_perc_source = SMCoreModel.Single_rate Then Return (1 + SMCoreModel.NonUnit_discount_perc + SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 Else Return (1 + Economic_curves.Value(Date.FromOADate(BalDate(t)), SMCoreModel.NOM_input()) + SMCoreModel.Investment_expense_perc + SMCoreModel.Int_margin_ind * SMCoreModel.Int_margin_val) ^ (1 / 12) - 1 End If End If
